name: Vampdoll no Hanayome: The Novel Game
original_name: 吸血鬼の花嫁 The Novel Game
source:
We set our scene in the Meiji era.

Having lost her grandmother, Shirafuji Sana found herself completely alone. With nowhere else to go and nothing to eat, she turned to the Imperial Army and its strange 'bride thorn' program.

Bride thorns are girls offered up as rations to the Vampdolls - blood-drinking women conscripted into the Army as its fiercest soldiers. Starved, desperate and completely unaware, Sana was made to sign an enlistment contract, only to be promptly introduced to Hanafusa Yukine, a beautiful, yet scornful Vampdoll.

At first, the two were far from an ideal match. With time, however, little by little, they began opening their hearts to one another. On their first night, they learned just how exhilarating - physically, emotionally - sucking blood can be. This came as a shock, but the two, awkwardly, trustingly, successfully made it through their first feeding.

Not long after that, they were sent out for active service and Yukine was incapacitated in the fighting...

[Translated from the official description]
translation:
我们把场景设定在明治时代。

失去了祖母后，白藤纱奈发现自己完全孤独了。由于无处可去，也没有东西吃，她转向帝国军队及其奇怪的“新娘刺”计划。

新娘荆棘是作为吸血鬼娃娃的口粮提供的女孩——这些吸血的女性被征召入伍，成为最凶猛的士兵。饥饿、绝望和完全不知情的萨那被迫签署了一份入伍合同，却很快被介绍给了美丽但轻蔑的吸血鬼花房雪音。

起初，两人远非理想的匹配。然而，随着时间的推移，他们逐渐开始向彼此敞开心扉。在他们的第一个晚上，他们了解到吸血是多么令人兴奋——无论是身体上还是情感上。这让人震惊，但两人笨拙地、充满信任地成功地完成了第一次喂食。

不久之后，他们被送去服役，而雪音则在战斗中丧失了行动能力……
